business.explanation: Rewrite of the spanner planner. The prior source produced empty/zero-length plans: its search loop recorded actions into the shared `plan` list and then restored state, but `search()` returned the alias `trial` list (which was never populated) and the final `plan` contents were wiped by `_restore`. The new version keeps an explicit `initial` snapshot, restores in place (mutating the same set/list objects so aliases stay valid), simulates each candidate order on the live state, verifies every goal fact is achieved before returning, and only then snapshots the action list. Returned strings use the domain's parameter order (walk start end man; pickup_spanner l s m; tighten_nut l s m n).
